t: A Renesas Wi-Fi 6 chip for low-power smart home gadgets.
steps: Buy the EK-RA6W1 kit from Renesas or a distributor such as DigiKey.
Install Renesas e2 studio on your computer.
Download the RAFW FSP software kit from Renesas on GitHub.
Read the kit quick start guide and connect the board over USB.
Build and flash a basic example with e2 studio or the Renesas Flash Programmer.
Try a Wi-Fi example that joins your home network.
Look at the Avnet IoTConnect FreeRTOS demo for a full cloud project.
Ask questions on the Renesas RA community forum.
meta: Open Code. From $69. A few stores.
